summaries: A Form 10-K Annual Report for BoxScore Brands, Inc. (which filed to change its name to American Battery Materials, Inc. in October 2022) for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. A Form 10-K Annual Report for American Battery Materials, Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: Documents the 2023 share capital structure, including 11,373,793 common shares outstanding at December 31, 2023. Records the conversion of 50,000 Series A Preferred shares to common stock during the year, leaving zero preferred shares outstanding. This document establishes the 2023 capital position but does not contain the 2024 Annual Report data.
